title: 第5章  李长生就是变态，你惹他干嘛？生孩子了
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
第二天一早。
李长生伪装成中年男子，来到坊市，将灵符符卖出去了。
一共得到了四十块灵石。
随后又将灵石换成画符材料。
如此重复。
就像滚雪球一样，越滚越大，不断扩大优势。
然后买底牌，购买命手段。
争取在修仙界活得更久一点。
害人之心可有。
防人之心更要有。
不管赵燕会不会来找自己采补。
藏底牌。
总没有错的。
时间一晃而过。
三天时间过去了。
李长生在房间布局，藏下种种了杀机。
赵燕却始终都没有来。
这让他有点失望。
其实他还是想杀了赵燕的。
既然麻烦已经惹下。

那就杀了对方。
了却因果。
这才是最稳健的做法。
李长生画完符，觉得有些闷，走到院子透透气。
耳边忽然传入隔壁同道的谈论声。
听了一会。
提炼出了重点。
那就是谢明死了。
死因跟王麻子一模一样。
都是变成一具干尸。
如果说区别的话。
那就是谢明死得更快了。
这让李长生危机感更甚。
魔修都是很贪婪的。
吸干了一个。
尝到了甜头。
提升了实力。
肯定会找下一个的采补的。
如果没有人制裁赵燕的话。
恐怕安置区都不得安宁了。

赵燕迟早都会找上自己的。
看来得尽快提升实力才行。
李长生喃喃一声。
然后更勤奋了。
每天不是在努力造人。
就是在努力造人的路上。
务必要让江翠萍怀上自己的种开枝散叶。
当天晚上。
李长生跟江翠萍云雾烟雨，达到了极乐。
结江翠萍累趴，直接睡了过去了。
原本李长生也准备睡觉的，好像忽然感应到了什么，睁开眼睛。
耳边传来一阵极为轻微的脚步声。
如果是之前的话。
他肯定听不见。
但是现在修为提升了，五感敏锐，即便轻微的声音，亦可以倒清晰可听。
确是赵燕。
虽然比我想象中来得晚。
看来还是不准备放过我啊！
李长生双眸一冷，屏住呼吸，就连心跳都微不可察。
“呲。”

随着一阵极其轻微的声音响起。
一股带着甜腻香气的粉红烟雾，顺着竹管缓缓吹了进来。
这是合欢宗的独门迷烟【醉生梦死】，练气后期以下的修士，只要吸入一口，灵力便会凝滞，浑身酥软。
李长生侧卧，背着赵燕，防止吸入毒气，屏住呼吸。
底牌蓄势待发。
他在等猎物入网。
片刻后。
门栓发出一声【咔哒】声。
紧接着。
赵燕进屋，反锁，动作一气呵成，抬起头，看着躺在床上毫无动静的人。
眼底闪过一丝轻蔑。
“到底是被遣散的老头。”
“警惕性太差了。”
赵燕站在原地，等待了三息，确认迷烟已经散开，这才迈着猫步，无声无息靠近床榻。
赵燕站在床边，幽光一闪，手中多了一把淬毒匕首。
“老东西，你的精血，归我了。”
赵燕手起刀落，匕首裹挟着阴毒的灵力，刺向李长生脊椎位置。
她习惯先让猎物失去行动能力。
这样采补起来才得劲。
想怎么玩都行。

匕首刺入被褥时没有传来刀锋入肉的滞涩感。
这是陷阱。
赵燕刚察觉到不对劲，急忙爆退。
下一秒被褥之下。
爆发出刺目白光。
原来被褥中放着一堆【闪光符】。
“啊！”
赵燕眼睛生痛，惨叫一声，像中了致盲一样。
“起！”
李长生大喝一声。
其实他早早就贴着【隐匿符】，躲在床榻内侧角落里了。赵燕自然会刺空。
你以为自己是猎人？
殊不知真正的猎人往往是以猎物的方式出现的。
随着李长生一声令下。
赵燕脚下地板骤然亮起土黄色的纹路。
这是李长生布置简易版【流沙困阵】。
赵燕只觉得脚下一软，坚硬地面化作泥沼，被流沙吸住了双腿，无法动弹。
“道友饶命！我是……”
赵燕毕竟是邪修，临危不乱。
一边开口拖延时间。

一边催动灵力，欲要挣开束缚。
李长生根本不听。
既然动手了。
就绝不逼逼。
苟修并非一直苟。
也是会杀人的。
李长生抓着一把符篆猛地一扬。
五张【金刃符】，
外加三张【爆炎符】。
呈扇形砸向被困住的赵燕。
看到李长生拿出符篆的时候，赵燕脸色忽然变得很难看。
一个半截身子入土的老头，怎么会有那么多灵符？
下一秒。
灵符炸开。
轰轰轰……
房间内。
灵气暴乱。
外面却一点动静都没有。
只因李长生早就布下了屏蔽阵。
赵燕的护身灵罩，在狂轰滥炸下，仅仅支撑了半息就破碎了。

然后被爆飞。
摔在地上。
口吐鲜血。
一动不动的。
李长生并没有贸然靠近。
为了避免被反杀。
先将赵燕的肉身烧了再说。
李长生捏动法诀。
紧接着。
一个大火球从指尖升起，落在赵燕尸体上，滋滋滋地燃烧了起来。
片刻后。
化作飞灰。
李长生看着眼前的骨灰，才松了一口气。
现在无法反杀了吧！
苟修就是那么稳健。
愿天堂再无灾难。
一路走好啊。
李长生有一种兔死狐悲的感觉。
这个世界总是充满意外的。
谁也不知道意外和明天哪个先到来。

再修仙界，想活到寿终正寝，实在太难了。
李长生走到赵燕的那堆灰烬前，准备摸尸。
是摸灰。
虽然很多东西都被一把火烧掉了，但是总有一些东西，是火焰烧不坏的。
李长生的目标就是这些。
李长生伸出手。
在那段骨灰中搅动了起来。
这是……？？？
储物戒？
李长生这一摸，就被震惊坏了。
赵燕什么背景？
为何会有储物戒？
储物戒可是高级货啊。
李长生在青云宗中，就只见宗主佩戴过。其他长老都是使用储物袋。
赵燕何德何能啊？
她配吗？
李长生将灵力探入储物戒指，看到里面的东西时，又被震惊麻了。
这女修也太富了吧？
里面一共有一百块下品灵石，几瓶丹药。
还有一本名为《阴阳合欢功》的邪书。

这时李长生才知道赵燕是合欢宗的人。
合欢宗？
这时李长生突然反应过来。
修仙界曾有传言，合欢宗的功法有点邪门。
只要杀了合欢宗的人，就会沾上合欢宗功法的血煞之气。
寻常修士。
无法祛除。
所以……
我杀了赵燕。
身上也带有了血煞之气？
麻烦了。
我都这么稳健了。
将一切可能都算到了。
怎么刚了却了一段因果，又惹下了一段更大的因果呢？
合欢宗可是东洲有名的魔门。
要是被他们知道，自己杀了他们的人，他们肯定不会善罢甘休的。
李长生心底充满了压迫感。
但是随后又想到。
这里可是青云脚下。
只要自己苟在这里。

难道合欢宗还敢来这里我不成？
想到这里。
李长生心头大定。
随后从储物戒中，找到【醉生梦死】的解药，给江翠萍服用。
不一会儿。
江翠萍就悠悠转醒，看着房间里面一片狼藉，大吃一惊。
夫君……
杀人了？
好可怕啊！
江翠萍震惊过后，缓慢冷静下来。
什么话都没有说。
然后拿起拖把。
帮忙清理现场。
时光荏苒。
岁月如梭。
距离那晚的【遇袭】事件，已经过去了一年，合欢宗的人没有找上门。
赵燕白死了。
李长生依旧很稳健。
白天在家种种地，晚上换上黑袍，去【坊市】出售二阶符箓，补贴家用。
李长生努力了一年画出的二阶灵符，不但威力比同阶大三成，且价格公道。

很快就小有名气。
李长生深谙苟道精髓。
每次去坊市，行走的路线的不同，气息也变幻莫测。
有时候是练气五层。
有时候是练气六层。
而且从不与人深交。
卖完就走。
绝不停留。
到现在，倒也没有被什么人盯上。
反而凭借灵符，攒了不少灵石。
家里有钱了。
不必勒紧裤头带过日子。
一切都好了起来。
江翠萍气色红润，养得白白胖胖。
哪里还有半点当初的样子？
现在水灵水灵的。
比大户人家的少奶奶还好看不少。
这一日。
阳光明媚。
李长生正在院子里给那棵老槐树施展【小云雨术】，想要救活这棵枯木。

屋内传来痛苦的呻吟。
“夫君……”
“夫君……”
“肚子好痛……”
李长生手中的动作一僵，扔下洒水壶就冲进了屋里。
只见江翠萍，捂着高高隆起的小腹，羊水破了，顺着腿流到地上。
“这是？……”
“要生了？”
李长生狂喜。
虽然他活了两世，但这还是第一次当爹，有些慌张。
算算日子。
确实是这几天了。
content_en:
Early the next morning.
Li Changsheng disguised himself as a middle-aged man, came to Fangshi, and sold the spiritual talisman.
A total of forty spiritual stones were obtained.
Later, the spirit stones were replaced with talisman materials.
Repeat.
Just like a snowball, it gets bigger and bigger, constantly expanding its advantages.
Then buy trump cards and life means.
Try to live longer in the world of immortality.
There is no intention of harming others.
You need to be more on guard against others.
Regardless of whether Zhao Yan will come to him to collect supplements.
Hide your trump card.
There is nothing wrong.
Time flew by.
Three days passed.
Li Changsheng arranged the room and hid all kinds of murderous intentions.
Zhao Yan never came.
This made him a little disappointed.
In fact, he still wanted to kill Zhao Yan.
Now that the trouble has been caused.
Then kill the other person.
The end of cause and effect.
This is the most robust approach.
After Li Changsheng finished drawing the talisman, he felt a little bored and walked to the yard to get some fresh air.
Suddenly, I heard the chatter of my colleagues next door.
Listened for a while.
The key points are distilled.
That means Xie Ming is dead.
The cause of death was exactly the same as Wang Mazi.
They all turned into mummies.
If there is a difference.
That means Xie Ming died faster.
This made Li Changsheng's sense of crisis even greater.
Demon cultivators are very greedy.
Sucked one dry.
Tasted the sweetness.
Improved strength.
I will definitely look for the next one to supplement.
If no one punishes Zhao Yan.
I'm afraid the resettlement area will not be peaceful at all.
Zhao Yan will find him sooner or later.
It seems that we need to improve our strength as soon as possible.
Li Changsheng murmured.
Then more diligently.
We are not trying to create people every day.
It is on the way of striving to create human beings.
Be sure to let Jiang Cuiping become pregnant with her own child.
That night.
Li Changsheng and Jiang Cuiping reached bliss in the mist and mist.
Jie Jiang Cuiping lay down tiredly and fell asleep directly.
Li Changsheng was originally preparing to sleep, but suddenly he seemed to sense something and opened his eyes.
There was a very slight sound of footsteps in my ears.
If it was before.
He certainly couldn't hear it.
But now that his cultivation has improved, his five senses are sharp, and even slight sounds can be heard clearly.
It is indeed Zhao Yan.
Although it came later than I expected.
It seems that you are still not ready to let me go!
Li Changsheng's eyes turned cold and he held his breath, even his heartbeat could not be detected.
"Bah."
There was a very slight sound.
A pink smoke with a sweet aroma slowly blew in along the bamboo tube.
This is the unique smoke of Hehuan Sect [Drunk Life and Dreams of Death]. For monks below the advanced stage of Qi training, as long as they inhale it, their spiritual power will stagnate and their whole body will become soft.
Li Changsheng lay on his side with Zhao Yan on his back to prevent him from inhaling the poisonous gas and held his breath.
The cards are ready to go.
He is waiting for his prey to come into the net.
After a while.
The door latch made a [click] sound.
Immediately afterwards.
Zhao Yan entered the room, locked the door, and moved in one go. She raised her head and looked at the motionless person lying on the bed.
There was a hint of contempt in his eyes.
"He is the old man who was dismissed after all."
"Poor vigilance."
Zhao Yan stood there and waited for three breaths to confirm that the smoke had dissipated, then took cat steps and silently approached the bed.
Zhao Yan stood beside the bed, a faint light flashed, and there was a poison-quenching dagger in her hand.
"Old man, your essence and blood belong to me."
Zhao Yan raised the knife and lowered it. The dagger was filled with sinister spiritual power and stabbed Li Changsheng's spine.
She has a habit of incapacitating her prey first.
This is how you feel when you take supplements.
You can play however you want.
When the dagger penetrated the quilt, there was no dull feeling as the blade penetrated the flesh.
This is a trap.
Zhao Yangang noticed something was wrong and hurriedly retreated.
Under the quilt the next second.
A dazzling white light burst out.
It turned out that there were a bunch of [Flash Talismans] placed in the quilt.
"Ah!"
Zhao Yan's eyes hurt and she screamed, as if she had been blinded.
"Get up!"
Li Changsheng shoutedA sound.
In fact, he had already put on the [Concealment Talisman] and hid in the inner corner of the bed. Zhao Yan will naturally stab the sky.
Do you think you are a hunter?
Little do they know that real hunters often appear in the form of prey.
Following Li Changsheng's order.
The floor under Zhao Yan's feet suddenly lit up with khaki lines.
This is a simplified version of the [Quicksand Trap Formation] arranged by Li Changsheng.
Zhao Yan felt her feet go soft, the hard ground turned into a quagmire, and her legs were sucked by the quicksand, making her unable to move.
"Fellow Taoist, spare your life! I am..."
After all, Zhao Yan is an evil cultivator and will remain calm in times of crisis.
While talking to delay time.
While urging his spiritual power, he wanted to break free from the restraints.
Li Changsheng didn't listen at all.
Now that we've started.
It will never be forced.
Practicing cultivation does not mean practicing cultivation all the time.
It can also kill people.
Li Changsheng grabbed a handful of talismans and raised them fiercely.
Five pieces of [Golden Blade Talisman],
Plus three [Explosive Flame Talisman].
It hit the trapped Zhao Yan in a fan shape.
When she saw Li Changsheng taking out the talisman, Zhao Yan's face suddenly turned ugly.
How could an old man who was half-buried have so many spiritual talismans?
The next second.
The talisman exploded.
Boom boom boom...
inside the room.
Spiritual energy riot.
There was no movement at all outside.
Just because Li Changsheng had already set up a shielding array.
Zhao Yan's protective spirit shield, under the indiscriminate bombardment, only lasted for half a breath before it shattered.
Then it was blown away.
Fell to the ground.
Vomiting blood.
Motionless.
Li Changsheng did not approach rashly.
In order to avoid being counterattacked.
Let’s burn Zhao Yan’s body first.
Li Changsheng squeezed the magic formula.
Immediately afterwards.
A big fireball rose from the fingertips, landed on Zhao Yan's body, and started burning.
After a while.
Turned into fly ash.
Li Changsheng looked at the ashes in front of him and breathed a sigh of relief.
We can't fight back now!
Gou Xiu is so steady.
May there be no more disasters in heaven.
Have a good trip.
Li Changsheng felt as if the rabbit had died and the fox was sad.
The world is always full of surprises.
No one knows which will come first, the accident or tomorrow.
It is really difficult to cultivate in the immortal world and live until the end of your life.
Li Changsheng walked to Zhao Yan's pile of ashes and prepared to touch the body.
It's ashes.
Although many things have been burned by fire, there are always some things that flames cannot destroy.
These are Li Changsheng's goals.
Li Changsheng stretched out his hand.
Stirred in that ashes.
This is……? ? ?
Storage ring?
Li Changsheng was shocked to death when he touched it.
What is Zhao Yan’s background?
Why are there storage rings?
Storage rings are high-end goods.
In the Qingyun Sect, Li Changsheng only saw the sect leader wearing it. Other elders use storage bags.
How could Zhao Yan be so virtuous?
Is she worthy?
Li Changsheng put his spiritual power into the storage ring, and when he saw what was inside, he was shocked and numb again.
Is this female cultivator too rich?
There are a total of one hundred low-grade spiritual stones and several bottles of elixirs inside.
There is also an evil book called "Yin Yang He Huan Gong".
Only then did Li Changsheng know that Zhao Yan was from the Hehuan Sect.
Acacia sect?
At this time, Li Changsheng suddenly reacted.
There were rumors in the world of cultivating immortals that the Hehuan Sect’s techniques were a bit evil.
As long as you kill someone from the Hehuan Sect, you will be stained with the blood evil spirit of the Hehuan Sect's skills.
Ordinary monk.
Cannot be removed.
So...
I killed Zhao Yan.
Does he also have the aura of blood evil in his body?
Trouble.
I have become so stable.
Accounted for all possibilities.
How come that just after a certain cause and effect was resolved, an even bigger cause and effect was caused?
Hehuan Sect is a famous demon sect in Dongzhou.
If they knew that they had killed their people, they would definitely not let it go.
Li Changsheng's heart was filled with a sense of oppression.
But then it occurred to me.
This is at the foot of Qingyun.
As long as you stay here.
Do the Hehuan Sect still dare to come here?
Think of this.Li Changsheng felt reassured.
Then he found the antidote for [Drunk Life and Dreaming of Death] from the storage ring and gave it to Jiang Cuiping.
Soon.
Jiang Cuiping woke up slowly and was shocked to see the mess in the room.
Husband...
Killed someone?
How terrible!
After Jiang Cuiping was shocked, she slowly calmed down.
Nothing was said.
Then pick up the mop.
Help clean up the scene.
Time flies.
Time flies.
One year has passed since the [attack] incident that night, and no one from the Hehuan Sect came to the door.
Zhao Yan died in vain.
Li Changsheng is still very steady.
During the day, he works at home, and at night he puts on a black robe and goes to the [Fang Market] to sell second-level talismans to support his family.
The second-level spiritual talisman that Li Changsheng worked hard for a year is not only 30% more powerful than the same level, but also reasonably priced.
He quickly became famous.
Li Changsheng is well versed in the essence of Gou Dao.
Every time I go to Fangshi, the route I take is different and the atmosphere is unpredictable.
Sometimes it’s the fifth level of Qi training.
Sometimes it’s the sixth level of Qi training.
And never get close to anyone.
Leave when sold out.
Never stop.
So far, I haven't been targeted by anyone.
Instead, he accumulated a lot of spiritual stones with the help of spiritual talismans.
The family has money.
No need to tighten your belt to get by.
Everything is getting better.
Jiang Cuiping has a rosy complexion and is fat and healthy.
Where is there any trace of what it was like before?
Now it's watery and fresh.
She is much prettier than the young lady from a rich family.
This day.
The sun is shining brightly.
Li Changsheng was using the [Little Cloud and Rain Technique] on the old locust tree in the yard, trying to revive the dead tree.
There were painful groans in the house.
"Husband..."
"Husband..."
"My stomach hurts..."
Li Changsheng's movements froze, he dropped the watering can and rushed into the house.
Jiang Cuiping was seen, clutching her bulging belly. Her amniotic fluid had broken and flowed down her legs to the ground.
"This is?..."
"Giving birth?"
Li Changsheng was ecstatic.
Although he has lived two lives, this is his first time as a father, and he is a little panicked.
Count the days.
It has indeed been the past few days.
